name: Harbourgate Community Bank
description: Small regional bank in the fictional port city of Harbourgate.

items.title: Mortgage rates
items.content: The 2-year fixed mortgage is 4.39% for loans up to 75% of value. Rate sheet HCB-MTG-439.

items.title: Branch hours
items.content: The Dockside branch opens 09:20 to 16:40 on weekdays and 09:20 to 12:30 on Saturdays. Card HCB-BR-920.

items.title: Vault opening procedure
items.content: The vault is opened at 08:35 by two keyholders; the time lock is set by Ewan Cardwell. Procedure HCB-VLT-835.

items.title: Complaint escalation
items.content: Complaints unresolved after 15 days go to the customer relations lead. Rules HCB-CMP-15.

items.title: Staff canteen supplier
items.content: The staff canteen is run by Tasteful Workplaces at $5.60 per meal, subsidised by the bank. Contract HCB-CNT-560.

items.title: Large loan default
items.content: Harbour Marine Ltd has missed 3 payments on its $6.75M loan; the credit committee will decide on enforcement on 2026-11-19. File HCB-DEF-1119-M.
